gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests how {@link Tag} treats letter case when resolving tags by name.
ADDED i2: When tags are looked up with the default HTML parse settings (which normalise the case), names that differ only in case resolve to the same tag.
ADDED i3: The lookup normalises case using the default locale, so exercise it under several locales.
ADDED i4: Tag.valueOf normalises the name, so "script" and "SCRIPT" are equal tags.
ADDED i5: A shared TagSet caches known tags, so the two names resolve to the very same instance.
ADDED i6: The plain {@link Tag#valueOf(String)} preserves case, so names that differ only in case produce distinct (non-equal) tags.
